# Earth.com

> > Earth.com delivers daily science, environmental, and wildlife news alongside comprehensive educational resources including Earthpedia encyclopedias, NASA/ESA imagery galleries, and nature videos.

Founded by Eric Ralls, Earth.com combines breaking news coverage on topics from astronomy to conservation with extensive reference materials including plant taxonomies, animal guides, and beginner-friendly educational content. The platform integrates with EarthSnap and features curated imagery from NASA, ESA, ISS, and Hubble.

## Key Topics

- Earth science
- Environmental news
- Wildlife and conservation
- Earthpedia encyclopedia
- Plant taxonomy and identification
- Space photography and astronomy
- Satellite imagery and Earth observation
- Climate and sustainability
- Nature and biodiversity
- NASA and ESA missions
- International Space Station
- Mental health research
- Tree species identification
- EarthSnap platform

## Core Pages

- [Earth.com -- Earth News, Earth Images, Earth Videos](https://earth.com): Homepage featuring earth science, environmental news, and wildlife content
- [Earth News - Earth.com](https://earth.com/news): Main news hub covering science, environment, wildlife, and climate stories
- [Earthpedia - Learn about plants, animals, and more! - Earth.com](https://earth.com/earthpedia): Main encyclopedia hub for plants, animals, and natural history education
- [About Us - Earth.com - Earth News, Earth Images, Earth Knowledge](https://earth.com/about): About page detailing Earth.com mission, founder Eric Ralls, and EarthSnap

## Image & Video Galleries

- [Earth Images - Earth.com](https://earth.com/image): Daily images from ESA featuring stellar nurseries and space photography
- [Image Gallery - Earth.com](https://earth.com/image-gallery): Curated galleries of NASA, ISS, MODIS, and satellite Earth imagery
- [Earth Videos - Earth.com](https://earth.com/video): Video library featuring science, nature, and Hubble space discoveries
- [Photos from the International Space Station - Earth.com - Earth Image Gallery](https://earth.com/gallery/international-space-station-photos/6): ISS photo gallery featuring Sutter Buttes in Central California

## Featured News & Breaking Stories

- [Latest News on Space, Nature, Science & Environment | Earth.com](https://earth.com/news-category/breaking-news): Breaking news on black holes, bumblebees, and environmental science
- [Dark matter doesn't exist and the universe is 27 billion years old - Earth.com](https://earth.com/news/dark-matter-does-not-exist-universe-27-billion-years-old-study): Rajendra Gupta's alternative CCC+TL cosmology model challenges dark matter
- [U.S. earthquake fault is labeled as "one of Earth's biggest hazards" - Earth.com](https://earth.com/news/most-dangerous-part-of-this-west-coast-earthquake-fault-cascadia-subduction-zone): Cascadia Subduction Zone megathrust fault poses major West Coast tsunami risk
- [World Oceans Day 2025: Protecting the waters that give Earth life - Earth.com](https://earth.com/news/world-oceans-day-2025-sustaining-what-sustains-us): UN World Oceans Day 2025 coverage on ocean conservation and climate impact
- [Dinosaur eggs as large as cannonballs are found filled with giant crystals](https://earth.com/news/dinosaur-eggs-the-size-of-cannon-balls-are-found-filled-with-giant-crystals): Crystal-filled ornithopod eggs discovered in China's Qianshan Basin
- [Scientists have changed their minds again about Earth's core - Earth.com](https://earth.com/news/composition-of-earths-inner-core-contains-more-carbon-than-first-believed): University of Leeds research on carbon in Earth's inner core crystallization

## Beginner Guides & Educational Resources

- [A Beginner's Guide to Tree Identification - Earth.com](https://earth.com/earthpedia-articles/a-beginners-guide-to-tree-identification): Tree identification basics covering conifers and broadleaf species
- [Houseplant Identification 101: Identify Plants in Your House - Earth.com](https://earth.com/earthpedia-articles/houseplant-identification-101): Guide to identifying common houseplants like pothos, snake plant, and ficus
- [A Beginner's Guide to Mycology - Earth.com](https://earth.com/earthpedia-articles/a-beginners-guide-to-mycology): Beginner's introduction to fungi, mycelia, and mycology basics
- [Dolphins: Everything you need to know - Earth.com](https://earth.com/earthpedia-articles/dolphin-everything-you-need-to-know-about-these-magical-mammals): Comprehensive guide to dolphin species, behavior, and conservation
- [What is Proterozoic? - Earth.com](https://earth.com/earthpedia-articles/proterozoic): Geological eon overview covering Snowball Earth and early life evolution
- [A Beginner's Guide to Sleep Debt - Earth.com](https://earth.com/earthpedia-articles/a-beginners-guide-to-sleep-debt): CDC-based guide to sleep deficit and chronic sleep restriction effects

## Wildlife & Environmental Research

- [Human 'foster parents' guide the bald ibis back to life- Earth.com](https://earth.com/news/human-foster-parents-guide-an-extinct-bird-back-to-life): Waldrappteam's human-led migration reintroduces northern bald ibis to Europe
- [Forever chemicals found in everyday items may speed up aging - Earth.com](https://earth.com/news/forever-chemicals-found-in-everyday-items-may-speed-up-aging): PFAS research from Shanghai Jiao Tong University on biological aging
- [Plants have a secret 'breathing' strategy in response to heat - Earth.com](https://earth.com/news/plants-have-a-secret-breathing-strategy-in-response-to-heat): UC San Diego research on stomata regulation during temperature stress
- [Lemurs rely on memory, smell, and social tips to find food - Earth.com](https://earth.com/news/lemurs-rely-on-memory-smell-and-social-tips-to-find-food): NYU study reveals lemur foraging strategies using memory and olfaction

## Plant Encyclopedia (Earthpedia)

- [Dianthus Chinensis -- Earthpedia plant](https://earthpedia.earth.com/plant-encyclopedia/angiosperms/caryophyllaceae/dianthus-chinensis): Plant encyclopedia entry for China pink (Dianthus chinensis) taxonomy
- [Abies Alba -- Earthpedia plant](https://earthpedia.earth.com/plant-encyclopedia/gymnosperms/pinaceae/abies-alba): European silver fir encyclopedia entry covering range and characteristics
- [Dipterocarpus Intricatus -- Earthpedia plant](https://earthpedia.earth.com/plant-encyclopedia/angiosperms/dipterocarpaceae/dipterocarpus-intricatus): Southeast Asian deciduous tree found in Thailand, Cambodia, Laos, Vietnam
- [Celosia Argentea Argentea -- Earthpedia plant](https://earthpedia.earth.com/plant-encyclopedia/angiosperms/amaranthaceae/celosia-argentea-argentea): Silver cock's comb ornamental plant care and cultivation guide
- [Celtis Australis Australis -- Earthpedia plant](https://earthpedia.earth.com/plant-encyclopedia/angiosperms/cannabaceae/celtis-australis-australis): Celtis australis deciduous tree morphology and growth characteristics
- [Papaver Radicatum Stefanssonii -- Earthpedia plant](https://earthpedia.earth.com/plant-encyclopedia/angiosperms/papaveraceae/papaver-radicatum-stefanssonii): Poppy species entry detailing flower morphology and taxonomy
